description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with Supabase, including user row management, health checks, and demo data fetching. It exports functions for ensuring user data, inserting user rows, upserting user profiles, and performing health checks, with internal utility functions for data normalization.

methods.name: safeTrim
methods.description: Trims a string value safely, converting nullish values to empty strings before trimming.

methods.name: normalizeNullable
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string or null if empty.

methods.name: ensureUserRow
methods.description: Ensures a user row exists for the authenticated user, inserting or updating as needed.

methods.name: insertUserRow
methods.description: Inserts a new user row into the database with provided data.

methods.name: upsertOwnUserRow
methods.description: Calls a stored procedure to create or update the current user's profile.

methods.name: demoInsertUserRow
methods.description: Demo function for manual testing that inserts a sample user row.

methods.name: supabaseHealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a minimal check of Supabase configuration and session status.

methods.name: fetchDemoRows
methods.description: Fetches a few rows from a specified demo table for testing purposes.
